description: Which registrars has ICANN acted against? Lists the Contractual Compliance notices in this register — breach, suspension and termination — newest first, with the registrar, the date as ICANN prints it, the notice PDF and a verbatim quote of the notice line. Filter by action type or by date to see recent enforcement. Screening one firm and would otherwise call several registers by hand? `screen_firm` at referencesource.org/mcp/screen answers this register and three others in one call.

action.description: Optional: only this kind of notice.

since.description: Optional ISO date, e.g. "2024-01-01". Only notices dated on or after it. ICANN prints dates in long form ("20 November 2017"); this filter compares an ISO form computed from that string here.

name: list_enforcement_actions

also_reported.description: Values for this record reported by a SECOND source, each with its own source_url and source_quote. Cite these to the page they name, never to the record's primary source.

enforcement_date_iso.description: The same date in ISO form, computed here for ordering and filtering. It is NOT text from ICANN's page — quote enforcement_date when citing.

record_url.description: This record's own page on referencesource.org.

source_quote.description: Verbatim text from that page containing the value.

source_url.description: The page the value was read from.

under_review.description: PRESENT ONLY when a re-reading of this record's own source page states a different value from the one published here. Each named field's value is unsettled and must be cited as disputed, not as the publisher's current position. Absent means no correction is on file for this record — it is never returned empty.

reported_on.description: The date we re-read the page.

reported_value_found_in_that_quote.description: Whether the NEW value was found verbatim inside the new quote. False means the re-reading is not itself quote-confirmed.

title: List ICANN enforcement notices
